svg.text: Inside a Generated Repository: Every File, Its Responsibility, and the Tier It Serves (OSS + Google)
Real structure of generated-repos/gcp-adk-loop-circuit-breaker — ADK (Apache-2.0) and OpenHands (MIT) are both open source; Google Cloud is the deploy target.
Agent constitution read at every session start
Post ID, primary source, Rule 55 routing, OSS pairing, verification command
Pinned in Vertex KV / vLLM prefix cache
Tells the open-source autonomous agent how to build, test, and commit here
GitHub + local ADK service; nothing else mounted by default
Vertex AI global or vLLM via LiteLLM
Animated SVG/GIF for LinkedIn; editable Draw.io for architects
Google + OSS primitives on every step
Spoken talk track per slide; Proprietary + Confidential footer
Cloud Run v2 (Knative-based) + Artifact Registry + least-privilege IAM
Readers trust a repository when every file has one responsibility and one tier — and when they can swap any managed service for its open-source twin.
Curated by Nitin Aggarwal • Google Cloud ADK + OpenHands Factory • Proprietary + Confidential
Sources: Prashant Rathi repo structure (POST-06) • OpenHands factory output • google/adk-python
